Commentary.Commentary: Right then, despite the delay and the shortened game, we have witnessed quite a contest. Bangladesh finally break their duck on this tour and get a ‘W’ against their name to continue their dominance over West Indies in the ODI format. West Indies need to find a way to end their ODI losing streak against Bangladesh. The 2nd ODI will be played at the same venue on Wednesday, the 13th of July at 7.00 pm IST (1.30 pm GMT). But do join us in advance for the build-up. Till then, goodbye and take care!

Tamim Iqbal, the Bangladesh captain, says that the wicket was difficult for both teams but the best part for him was winning the toss, and he is very pleased with the bowling effort. On being asked about his wicket, he says that it's not a blame game, nobody does this intentionally but he is happy as in the end, they won the game. Mentions that they still have to apply themselves better. On Nasum Ahmed, he says that he was amazing, he did not disappoint here and he bowled really well.

Nicholas Pooran the skipper of West Indies says that the runs were not enough on the board, but it was not easy to score runs. Adds that the last wicket partnership gave them a chance, and put a defendable total on the board. Mentions that they should have played well in the Powerplay. On Gudakesh Motie he says that he bowled well, he is happy with his performance and he hopes he does well in the future as well.

Mehidy Hasan is the Player of the Match. He says that he is really happy with the performance. Adds that they have not had good enough time for practice due to rain but this win was very pleasing. Mentions that he is happy with the conditions as well, he tried to bowl in the right areas and that's why he was rewarded. Says that they have done well in this format, they did well against South Africa as well and they will want to carry this forward in the next game as well.
Stay tuned for the presentation...

Bangladesh on the other hand have won this game mainly because of their bowlers who controlled proceedings throughout the first half of the game. The bowlers we right on the money in the first innings. They dismissed West Indies for a below-par score of 149. However, they will be hoping for more support from the fielders who dropped multiple catches to extend the West Indies innings. In reply, they had useful contributions from Tamim Iqbal and Najmul Hossain Shanto and in the end, Mahmudullah top-scored with an unbeaten 41 to take the Bengal Tigers home. In the end, it's been a complete performance from Bangladesh, this is just what they need to boost their confidence after suffering defeats in the shortest format.

The hosts will be thoroughly disappointed by their overall display. Gudakesh Motie is the only one who bowled with any sort of rhythm as the rest of the bowlers lacked control and conceded runs freely. They did manage to grab an early wicket but they failed to capitalize on that. Nicholas Pooran will however be unhappy with how they performed with the bat. A few more runs on the board and things could have been different. Still, a few positives to take from this game. Gudakesh Motie on his debut was impressive and that certainly is a big boost for them. Also, the partnership for the last wicket for West Indies was another plus.

Bangladesh have finally picked up a victory on this tour and as expected it is in the format that they have been having the best time in! In the end, it was a comprehensive win as they got there with 6 wickets in hand and just under 10 overs left in the bag. Take this for a stat - West Indies have not beaten Bangladesh in an ODI game since December 2018 and have now lost 9 matches in a row. Barren run.

FOUR! Mahmudullah finishes things off in style! A shorter ball, around middle. Mahmudullah swivels and pulls it towards deep square leg for a boundary. Bangladesh win by 6 wickets with 55 balls remaining!
On a length, outside off. Mahmudullah pushes it to the fielder at cover.
Shorter ball now, outside off, tad slower as well. Nurul Hasan looks to pull this but the ball goes off his inside edge towards short fine leg for a single.
Angling in, on the pads, on a length. Mahmudullah tucks it through square leg and takes a single.
Back of a length, around middle and leg. Mahmudullah blocks it towards mid-wicket.
Jayden Seales (3-0-20-0) comes in to bowl.
On the pads now, fuller ball. Nurul Hasan flicks it towards deep square leg for a brace. Bangladesh are 5 runs away now!
Slower ball, outside off, this one keeps low as well. Nurul Hasan pushes it towards point once again.
Outside off, slower ball, around off. Nurul Hasan dabs it to the fielder at point.
Short this time, no pace on that one again, outside off. Mahmudullah cuts it towards point for a single.
Slower ball, on a length, outside off. Mahmudullah dabs it towards point.
Pitches it up, around middle. Nurul Hasan drives it down the ground for a single.
Anderson Phillip (1-0-11-0) is brought back into the attack.
Back of a length, outside off. Mahmudullah dabs it towards short third man. No run there! Bangladesh need only 9 runs.
Shorter ball, outside off. Mahmudullah pushes it off the back foot towards cover.
On the pads now, full in length. Mahmudullah tucks it fine towards fine leg for a brace.
Outside off, loopy one, full. Mahmudullah leans to block this but the ball goes off the outside edge towards short third man.
Quick again, full this time, around middle. Mahmudullah defends it out.
Swing and a miss! Short, outside off, quicker. Mahmudullah looks to cut this away but he misses.
Full, around middle and leg. Nurul Hasan defends this one. A maiden over to end Gudakesh Motie's spell!
Around middle and leg, fullish ball. Nurul Hasan tucks it towards square leg.
Shorter one, around off. Nurul Hasan pushes it towards cover. Four dots in a row!
Full again, around middle. Nurul Hasan defends this one watchfully.
Around middle and leg, full in length. Nurul Hasan flicks it towards mid-wicket.
A shorter one, spinning away, outside off, this one keeps low as well. Nurul Hasan pushes it off the back foot towards cover.
Loopy ball, around off, full. Mahmudullah blocks it solidly.
Tosses it up, pitches it up, around the leg pole. Mahmudullah flicks it towards square leg.
Full now, outside off. Mahmudullah drives and finds the fielder at cover.
Shorter now, around middle. Mahmudullah pushes it off the back foot towards cover.
SIX! KABOOM! Lovely shot! Fuller ball, around off. Mahmudullah shimmies down the pitch and tonks it high over long off for a biggie. Bangladesh need 11 runs more to win!
Tosses it up, full, on the pads. Nurul Hasan leans forward and tucks it towards square leg for a single.

DRINKS! Bangladesh are inching closer to victory. They need just 18 runs more to get over the line and clinch the first ODI. West Indies have tried hard but they didn't get much success. Also, Akeal Hosein comes back to bowl.
Short and wide outside off stump, Nurul Hasan strokes this towards deep cover for a single.

SIX! Nurul Hasan makes the most of the Free Hit! Nicholas Pooran bowls a full delivery in the slot and Nurul Hasan goes down on one knee to slog this high and handsome over the mid-wicket boundary for a biggie! Just 19 more runs required and Bangladesh should get home at a canter!
NO BALL! Nicholas Pooran floats a full toss outside off. Mahmudullah hits this firmly towards the long on fielder. However, he has overstepped once again and Nurul Hasan gets to face a Free Hit!
Goes fuller this time and angles it into the pads. Nurul Hasan clips this towards square leg for a single.
Nicholas Pooran continues bowling short outside off. Mahmudullah hits this hard past the cover fielder for a single.
Short once again outside off, Nurul Hasan plays this through cover for a single.
Nicholas Pooran sees Mahmudullah come down the wicket and bowls this short into the batter. Mahmudullah works this towards long on for one run.
A dot to end the over! Full and on middle. Nurul Hasan defends it out. Bangladesh need 31 more runs!
Nicely tossed up again, around middle. Nurul Hasan has defended this one solidly.
Pitches it up, around middle and off. Mahmudullah drives it towards long off. Single taken!
On the pads now, full in length. Mahmudullah tucks it to the fielder at square leg.
Another loopy ball, around middle. Nurul Hasan knocks it down to long off for a single.
Tosses it up, full, on middle. Nurul Hasan lunges forward and tries to block this but the ball goes off his outside edge towards short third man.
Full outside off, Mahmudullah taps this towards point. Just 2 runs from this over.
Nicholas Pooran serves this a fraction full on middle, Nurul Hasan works this towards long on for single.
Tosses this one full and angled into the pads, Mahmudullah flicks it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Shorter this time and on middle. Mahmudullah guides this towards mid-wicket.
This one is full and outside off. Mahmudullah knocks this straight to covers.

Nicholas Pooran begins with a short delivery pitching in line and turning towards leg. Mahmudullah tries to work this leg side and misses. There is a huge appeal as it hits the pads but the umpire does not agree. Nicholas Pooran does not review but replays show three reds and Mahmudullah would have been a goner!
Back of a length, spinning away, around off. Nurul Hasan pushes it to the fielder at cover.
Short this time, around middle. Nurul Hasan blocks this one off the back foot.
Another loopy ball, pitches it up, around middle and off. Nurul Hasan once again blocks it out watchfully.
Tosses it up, full, around off. Nurul Hasan presses forward and defends it out.
FOUR! Nurul Hasan gets off the mark in style! A shorter one, spinning away, some extra bounce there as well. Nurul Hasan stays back and punches it through covers for a boundary.
Loopy ball, around off, full. Nurul Hasan blocks it out solidly off the front foot.
Nurul Hasan comes to the crease.

OUT! CAUGHT! Nicholas Pooran finally gets his wicket! This one is really short and outside off, probably not a wicket-taking delivery, but gets Afif Hossain to go for a pull that he top-edges high towards long on. Anderson Phillip, who was at mid on, backtracks and takes a wonderful catch to get the skipper his first wicket of the game. Bangladesh still need 39 runs to win!
Commentary.Howout: c Anderson Phillip b Nicholas Pooran

Commentary.Commentary: Quick, full, and on middle. Afif Hossain blocks it out.
Fires this one on middle, full. Afif Hossain blocks it out.
Turn and bounce there! Full, spinning away, outside off. Afif Hossain tries to block this but he gets beaten on the outside edge.
Short again, outside off. Mahmudullah uses the depth of his crease and cuts it towards sweeper cover for a single.
Shorter, quick and around off. Mahmudullah makes room and pushes it towards cover.
Quicker, shorter, outside off. Afif Hossain hangs back and tries to cut this away but he misses.
Wide! Down the leg side, full again. Afif Hossain leaves it alone. Wide called.
Tosses it up, full, around off. Afif Hossain drives and finds the fielder at mid off.
Another full delivery, outside off. Afif Hossain once again blocks it out solidly.
Full, and outside off. Afif Hossain strides forward and blocks it out.
Slighlty short again, around off. Afif Hossain blocks it out.
Shortish ball, down the leg side. Afif Hossain looks to pull this one but he misses.
Slight halt! Mahmudullah is experiencing some cramps. The physio is out there to check on him.
Nicholas Pooran serves this one short on the pads, Afif Hossain guides this to mid-wicket for a single.
Flighted full and in line with the stumps. Afif Hossain defends this back down the pitch.
This one is also full but angling into the pads, Mahmudullah works it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Full delivery outside off, Mahmudullah goes for a slog sweep and misses the line once again.

NO BALL! What a disaster for West Indies! Nicholas Pooran decided to continue with his spell and it almost paid off! He flights this one full and gets it to land on off, Mahmudullah plays for the turn and tries to push at the delivery. The ball keeps it line and beats the inside edge of the bat to shatter the stumps. The West Indies players celebrate but the joy is short-lived as the third umpire has conveyed that it is a no-ball! Mahmudullah will continue to bat!
Goes shorter now outside off, Afif Hossain makes room and knocks it towards long off to get off strike.

FOUR! Afif Hossain gets his first boundary and how well has he played this! Nicholas Pooran flights this full and outside off, Afif Hossain guides this through covers with pure elegance! Bangladesh only need 45 more runs to win now!
Tosses it up, full and outside off. Afif Hossain pushes it towards cover for a run.
Very full, around middle, loopy one as well. Afif Hossain drives it through cover for a brace.
Shorter ball, around middle and leg. Afif Hossain blocks it out.
Afif Hossain comes to the crease.

OUT! TAKEN! Gudakesh Motie has his first wicket in ODIs! He gets rid of Najmul Hossain Shanto! A valuable wicket. Tosses this one up, full, and around middle. Najmul Hossain Shanto dances down the pitch, closes the face of the bat and clips it towards the fielder at mid-wicket. Nicholas Pooran holds on to that one! Bangladesh need 53 runs more!
Commentary.Howout: c Nicholas Pooran b Gudakesh Motie

Commentary.Commentary: Another full ball, around middle. Najmul Hossain Shanto steps down the pitch and clips it towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Tosses it up, full, on the pads. Najmul Hossain Shanto leans forward and flicks it to the fielder at square leg.
Full toss outside off, Najmul Hossain Shanto only manages to knock it towards long off for a single.
Flighted full on an off stump line, Najmul Hossain Shanto plays it back to Nicholas Pooran.
WIDE! This one is sliding down leg side from a full length. Najmul Hossain Shanto does not lay at it and is called wide.
Shorter this time but still attacking the stumps. Najmul Hossain Shanto defends this back down the pitch.
Full delivery outside off stump, Najmul Hossain Shanto fends this back towards the bowler.
FOUR! Poor delivery from Nicholas Pooran and gets the treatment! This on is really short and outside off. Najmul Hossain Shanto goes back and pulls this over mid-wicket for a cracking boundary!
Nicholas Pooran starts with a slightly short delivery in line with the stumps. Mahmudullah works this to long on for a single.
Another short delivery, outside off. Mahmudullah punches it towards deep cover for a run.
Tad shorter, around middle. Mahmudullah pushes it towards mid on.
Pitches it up again, around middle. Najmul Hossain Shanto flicks it towards mid-wicket and takes a quick single there!
A shout for an LBW, but the umpire says no! Fuller now, around off. Najmul Hossain Shanto looks to sweep this one but he misses. The impact was probably outside there!
Full and on the pads this time. Mahmudullah presses forward and taps it towards square leg for a single.
Slightly shorter, outside off, spinning away. Mahmudullah pushes it off the back foot towards point.
Full delivery with some sharp turn from outside off. Najmul Hossain Shanto gets beaten all ends up!
Slightly short and outside off, Mahmudullah goes back in the crease and works it towards deep cover for a single.
This one is a fraction full and pitching on middle, Najmul Hossain Shanto works this to backward square leg for a single.
Flights this full outside off and gets the ball to turn. Mahmudullah goes for the sweep and gets beaten by the spin.
Full and angling into the pads, Mahmudullah nudges it towards square leg for a single.
Full and on leg stump, Mahmudullah paddles it to the right of fine leg for a couple of runs.
This one turns in, shorter ball, around middle. Najmul Hossain Shanto works it away towards square leg.
Outside off now, full again. Najmul Hossain Shanto dabs it towards the fielder at short third man.
Fuller now, around middle. Najmul Hossain Shanto flicks it towards mid-wicket.
Slightly shorter, around middle and leg. Mahmudullah stays in his crease and tries to flick this but the ball goes off the leading edge away from the slip fielder. Single taken!
Slightly shorter, outside off. Mahmudullah blocks it out.
A loopy ball, yorker length, around middle. Mahmudullah makes room and digs this one out. The ball rolls just away from the off pole.
Low full toss going down leg, Mahmudullah sweeps but mistimes it towards fine leg for a single.
Full once again in line with the stumps. Najmul Hossain Shanto gets down the wicket and works it to long off for another single.
Full delivery, tossed up on middle and leg. Worked towards long on for a single.
Mahmudullah comes down the wicket and manages to york himself as he digs it out back to the bowler.
Slightly fuller now outside off, get the ball to keep its line. Mahmudullah plays for it and is beaten.
Nicholas Pooran goes short to begin with outside off, Mahmudullah nudges it towards mid-wicket.
Nicholas Pooran brings himself into the attack.
Full, around off. Najmul Hossain Shanto steps down the track and looks to flick this but he gets an inside edge back onto his boot.
Tosses this one up, full, around middle. Mahmudullah knocks it to long off for a single.
Shorter one, now outside off. Mahmudullah cuts it towards the fielder at point. Not in the gap though!
Pitches it up again, outside off. Mahmudullah drives this one but finds the fielder at cover.
Flatter this time, around middle. Mahmudullah blocks it out.
Fuller ball, around middle. Najmul Hossain Shanto steps down the pitch and pushes it to long on for a single.

DRINKS! Bangladesh are motoring along swiftly at the moment! They might have lost two wickets but are scoring at a rate of close to 6 runs per over. West Indies need wickets and they need them quickly. For now, it's all Bangladesh!
Goes a fraction short this time and on off, Mahmudullah guides this towards mid-wicket.
FOUR! Mahmudullah is looking good here! Akeal Hosein floats this one full and outside off, Mahmudullah plays this elegantly through the gap in extra cover for a beautiful boundary!
Short delivery outside off. Mahmudullah knocks this towards point.
Full delivery angled into the pads. Najmul Hossain Shanto manages to get a slight tickle off the bat that takes the ball to fine leg for a single.
Tosses this one full on off stump, Mahmudullah guides it though covers for a single.
Short once again but in line with the stumps. Najmul Hossain Shanto goes across the wicket and works it towards mid-wicket for a single.
WIDE! Begins with a slow half-tracker going down leg side. Najmul Hossain Shanto does not bother playing at it and is called wide.
Tad shorter, around middle. Mahmudullah blocks it out.
Overpitched delivery, on middle. This time Najmul Hossain Shanto connects his sweep shot towards deep square leg for a single.

Shout for an lbw, the finger goes up. Shanto is quick to take the DRS. A fuller ball, spinning in, around middle. Najmul Hossain Shanto gets down on his knee and tries to sweep this but he misses and gets hit on his back pad. A huge appeal for LBW, and the umpire raises his finger! Review time. Nothing on UltraEdge. The Ball Tracking indicates that the IMPACT IS OUTSIDE OFF. The on-field decision has to be overturned. Najmul Hossain Shanto survives, which means no wicket for Gudakesh Motie in his first over in ODIs.
Fuller one from over the wicket now, around off. Najmul Hossain Shanto taps it towards pont.
Shorter this time, spinning away, outside off. Mahmudullah uses the depth of his crease and punches it through cover for a single.
Begins with a loopy ball, full, around middle. Mahmudullah pushes it back to the bowler.
Gudakesh Motie the debutant, comes into the attack.

FOUR! Akeal Hosein fires in a quick delivery full and on middle. Najmul Hossain Shanto sweeps this hard past the square leg fielder and Gudakesh Motie makes a complete mess on the boundary! Dives to save four runs but in the end knocks the ball towards the boundary line himself! Bangladesh continue to score at a brisk rate as they get 7 runs from this over!
This one is slightly short and outside off, Mahmudullah makes room to hit this down the ground towards long off for a single.
Akeal Hosein delivers this a fraction short and on off, Najmul Hossain Shanto punches this down to long on for a single.
Full once again and in line with the stumps. Mahmudullah manages to work this towards backward square leg for a single.
Quicker delivery bowled on a shorter length and outside off. Mahmudullah fends this towards cover-point.
Akeal Hosein flights this full on middle, Mahmudullah hits this hard to the cover fielder.
Another slower ball, darting it on the pads, a length ball. Mahmudullah nudges it towards fine leg and takes a single. He retains the strike. Bangladesh are only 90 runs away!
Fraction short on this occasion, slow in pace as well, around off. Mahmudullah stays in his crease and pushes it towrads mid off.
On the pads now, a length ball. Najmul Hossain Shanto tucks it towards square leg for a single.
Wide! A slower ball, full and wide of off. Najmul Hossain Shanto leaves it alone. Wide called!
Serves a short ball, around off. Najmul Hossain Shanto dabs it towards point. No run taken this time.
Full now, outside off. Najmul Hossain Shanto drives and finds the fielder at extra-cover.
FOUR! Cracking shot! Back of a length, around the leg pole. Najmul Hossain Shanto pulls this towards deep square leg for a boundary.
Akeal Hosein goes for a quicker delivery speared into the stumps. Mahmudullah gets forward and defends this one solidly.
This one is served full in line with the stumps, Mahmudullah knocks the ball towards mid off.
Angles this full delivery down leg side. Najmul Hossain Shanto works this towards backward square leg for a single.
Akeal Hosein goes full once again and aims for the stumps. Najmul Hossain Shanto continues to play on the back foot and just about manages to keep the ball out.
Full delivery pitching on middle and leg, Najmul Hossain Shanto goes for the reverse sweep and plays it through cover-point for a couple of runs.
Full and attacking the stumps. Najmul Hossain Shanto defends this back to the bowler from deep in the crease.
Time for Powerplay 2! Now, a maximum of 4 fielders can be placed outside the inner circle till the 33rd over!
Shorter now, outside off. Mahmudullah pushes it off the back foot towards cover.
Outside off, on a good length. Mahmudullah cuts it towards the fielder at point.
Wide! On a length, sliding down the leg side. Mahmudullah misses his flick and a wide is called!
Mahmudullah comes to the crease.

OUT! RUN OUT! Oh, dear! A mix-up in the middle and Tamim Iqbal is on his way back. This is a huge, huge wicket for West Indies. A length ball, slow again, outside off. Najmul Hossain Shanto taps it towards point. After a bit of yes and no, the batter decide to take a single. Anderson Phillip collects the ball with his right hand and scores a direct hit at the keeper's end. Tamim Iqbal is nowhere near the crease. He walks back in disbelief and Bangladesh have lost their second wicket.
Slower ball at 119 clicks, on a length, outside off. Tamim Iqbal dabs it towards point and takes a single.
Pitches it up, outside off. Tamim Iqbal defends this one solidly off the front foot.
Wide! A length ball, down the leg side. Tamim Iqbal tries to flick but he misses. Wide given!
Romario Shepherd begins with a full delivery, outside off. Tamim Iqbal drives it fiemlu but finds the fielder at cover.
Romario Shepherd comes into the attack.
On a good length and outside off. Najmul Hossain Shanto miscues it towards the cover fielder. Another good over for Bangladesh!
Anderson Phillip goes full on the pads, Tamim Iqbal works this to fine leg and gets off strike.

FOUR! The skipper is leading from the front here! Back-of-a-length delivery outside off, Tamim Iqbal guides this beautifully past point for a boundary. This one is perfectly timed in the gap and easy pickings for the batter!
Full delivery going down leg side. Tamim Iqbal looks to flick this but misses and probably gets a bit of his pads as this has not been adjudged wide.

SIX! This is pure strength from Tamim Iqbal! Straying on the leg once again from a good length. Tamim Iqbal flicks this off his legs high to the left of backward square leg for the first six of the innings! Tamim Iqbal wants to get to the target quickly!
Anderson Phillip begins with a full delivery outside off stump, Tamim Iqbal looks to work this towards cover but only manages to mistime it towards mid-wicket.
Anderson Phillip is introduced into the attack.
Full, outside off. Najmul Hossain Shanto drives and finds the fielder at cover.
On a length, outside off. Tamim Iqbal taps it towards point. Single taken!
Pitches it up, around middle. Tamim Iqbal pushes it back to the bowler.
FOUR! A gift from Jayden Seales and Tamim Iqbal gleefully accepts it. A fuller ball, wide of off. Tamim Iqbal pushes it over cover for a boundary.

Quick single! Pulls his length back now, goes a tad shorter, around off. Najmul Hossain Shanto pushes it towards mid off and scampers across to the other end. There is a throw at the non-striker's end but away from the stumps. Direct hit and Najmul Hossain Shanto could have been in trouble.
Jayden Seales serves a fuller ball, outside off. Tamim Iqbal presses forward and drives it wide of mid off for a single.
Full delivery angled into the pads, Tamim Iqbal flicks this through mid-wicket for another single. 12 runs of the over and Bangladesh are getting a move on here.
This one is short and outside off, Najmul Hossain Shanto gets this to long on for a single.
FOUR! This one is absolutely muscled! Flighted delivery served full and outside off, Najmul Hossain Shanto sweeps this towards the mid-wicket fence for the second boundary of the over.
WIDE! Sharp turn as this is pitched short on middle and turns down leg side. Najmul Hossain Shanto tries to work this leg side and misses. The umpire calls this wide and Bangladesh get an extra run.
Akeal Hosein serves this fraction short in line with the stumps. Tamim Iqbal goes back in the crease and guides this to backward square leg for a single.

FOUR! This one is paddled fine by Tamim Iqbal! Akeal Hosein goes full once again and attacks the stumps. Tamim Iqbal goes down on his knees and works it to fine leg for a boundary! That should release some pressure!
Full and angling down leg, Tamim Iqbal taps it down towards short leg.
Back of a length, darting it on the thigh pads. Tamim Iqbal hops and works it away towards deep square leg for a single. He retains the strike.
Tad fuller, around off. Tamim Iqbal presses forward and blocks it out.
Angling in, on the pads, a length ball. Najmul Hossain Shanto tucks it to square leg and takes a single.
Back of a length, outside off. Najmul Hossain Shanto lets that go through to the keeper.
On a length, outside off. Najmul Hossain Shanto leaves it alone.

FOUR! Not the ideal shot but he will get a boundary for that! Fuller, around off. Najmul Hossain Shanto leans forward to drive but the ball goes off the inner half of the bat straight down the ground for a boundary.

Fuller ball, tad quicker, around middle. Najmul Hossain Shanto gets down on his knee and sweeps it through square leg for a single. He gets off the mark with that. End of a successful over from Akeal Hosein.
Wide! Sharp turn there! Another fuller ball, this one lands around middle and spins down the leg side. Najmul Hossain Shanto leaves it alone. Wide called!
A fuller ball from over the wicket, spinning in, around middle and off. Najmul Hossain Shanto strides forward and blocks it out.
Najmul Hossain Shanto walks out to bat at number 3.

OUT! LBW! West Indies have got the breakthrough! Just the start they were looking for! Akeal Hosein goes full and angles it in from outside off, Litton Das plays for the turn but the ball keeps its line and raps against the pads. West Indies players are convinced that this is plumb and after a long delay the umpire agrees with them. Litton Das goes for the review and UltraEdge shows there is no edge. Ball Tracking shows two reds and the third is the umpire's call as the ball is just clipping the leg stump. The on-field decision is upheld and Litton Das has to take a long walk back. He is furious as he has a few words to say to the umpire and then the West Indies players. Tamim Iqbal continues to argue with the umpire but there is nothing wrong with the decision here!
Pulls his length back and goes shorter as he bowls this in line with the stumps. Litton Das goes back in the crease and defends this towards covers.
This is short and wide outside off, Litton Das cannot make the most of it as he slashes this towards the point fielder.
Full delivery angled into the stumps, Tamim Iqbal works this towards long on for a single.
Back of a length, around middle and leg. Litton Das blocks it out off the back foot. 7 runs off Jayden Seales' first over!

On a length, outside off. Tamim Iqbal stays in his crease and tries to defend this, but he manages to get an outside edge just away from the backward slip fielder. Kyle Mayers there dives to his left and makes a half-stop. Single taken!
Pitches it up again, outside off. Litton Das tries to drive this but the ball goes off the inside edge towards square leg. Single taken and Litton Das gets off the mark with that.
On a length this time, outside off. Tamim Iqbal dabs it towards point and takes a single.

FOUR! Edgy boundary! Another full ball, wide of off this time. Tamim Iqbal leans forward and looks to drive this again, but the ball goes off the outside edge away from short third man for a boundary. First boundary of the innings!
Jayden Seales begins with a fuller ball, outside off at 132 clicks. Tamim Iqbal drives but finds the fielder at mid off.
Who will bowl from the other end? Jayden Seales it is!
Akeal Hosein fires this one in quicker and angles it into the stumps. Litton Das solid in defense this time. Good start for Akeal Hosein as he concedes one run from the first over!
Another lovely delivery as he flights this full outside off, Litton Das goes forward in defense and gets an outside edge that falls just short of the slip fielder.
Full once again in line with the stumps. Litton Das defends and gets an inside edge into the ground towards the leg side.

What a delivery as it rips off the surface. Akeal Hosein pitches this on off stump and full, gets the ball to turn away from the batter. Litton Das goes forward and pushes at it and gets beaten on his outside edge.
Akeal Hosein goes a fraction short and angles it into the pads, Tamim Iqbal works this towards backward square leg for a single.
Akeal Hosein begins with a full delivery spinning in from outside off, Tamim Iqbal defends it down into the wicket.
